text:
alex: FYI seeing a morning spike in WS reconnects for a handful of routes. Console flags them as `client_pause` but runtime logs show server PING -> no ACK -> close. Happening right as connections 'warm up'. any ideas?

maria: can you paste the log snippet & which region/route? also is this correlated with any config rollout?

alex: snippet below (edge logs):
```
[2026-02-25T08:21:03Z] conn=abcd ping_sent
[2026-02-25T08:21:05Z] conn=abcd ping_ack_miss
[2026-02-25T08:21:05Z] conn=abcd inflight_count=58 inflight_cap=64 warmup=true
[2026-02-25T08:21:06Z] conn=abcd close_by_server reason=heartbeat_timeout
```
Region: prod-west, route: /ws/generate, affected tenants: 3 high-parallelism customers.

ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: WS reconnect rate > 3x baseline (tenant=prod-west)

priya: this smells like the inflight-window ramp. we recently bumped default cap from 8->64 with a fast ramp, so during warmup a flurry of inflight frames can starve heartbeat processing and our quota/backpressure guards kick in. console shows client as culprit because it only sees the close event timestamped after the missing ACK.

jonathan: we don't currently tag metrics with 'warmup' anywhere. console SLO dashboards will treat these exactly the same as genuine client stalls. if we emit a transient tag during the first ~30s of connection we can filter/annotate.

maria: short term options: 1) slow the ramp (e.g. 8 -> 16 -> 32 -> 64 over 30s) 2) cap inflight at a lower value for first N requests 3) increase heartbeat priority handling so ACKs are processed before heavy KV/cache ops.

alex: can we toggle this with a feature flag? want a canary before global flip.

priya: yes we can add runtime.warmup_slow_ramp boolean. also propose emitting two low-cardinality metrics: `inflight_peak_warmup` and `heartbeat_ack_lag_sampled` (1% sampling) to avoid cardinality explosion. the sample should include route/edge and warmup=true tag.

maria: PR incoming with the slow-ramp and metric tagging. plan: roll canary 10% edge, monitor reconnect rate + heartbeat_ack_lag for 30m, then 100% if stable.

ops-bot: Deploy plan noted: PR #3456 by @maria — feature flag runtime.warmup_slow_ramp=true default on for canary group.

jonathan: console requests: add a dashboard tile 'Warmup reconnects' that filters by `warmup=true` and a panel for `heartbeat_ack_lag_sampled`. Also change the reconnect alert to ignore spikes that fully resolve within 2m or that are dominated by warmup=true.

alex: deploying canary to 10% now (canary start ts=1748503300). will report back in 15m.

maria: early numbers — reconnects on canary edges down ~60%, mean ack lag down ~40ms.

priya: good. remaining tail seems to come from tenants that open hundreds of concurrent sessions quickly. we might need a tenant-scoped inflight floor or per-tenant slow-ramp.

alex: I'll own follow-ups: 1) PR for metric tags/console tile (maria+jonathan) 2) rollout RFC for tenant-scoped ramp (priya) 3) short postmortem if it recurs.

maria: thanks — please ping when dashboard is live so support can triage with warmup filter.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary finish: 10% -> metrics look green at 1748503525

alex: noted. leaving this thread open for follow-up tasks. :thumbsup:
